name: MACD signal line cross (12, 26, 9)
description: TREND FOLLOWING. Gerald Appel's rule from the late 1970s: long when the MACD line crosses above its 9-period signal line, short on the opposite cross. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: 12/26/9 are Appel's own, chosen for daily bars back when a trading week was six days. BORN ON THE DAILY, on equities. The crossing measures a smoothed change of momentum; on intraday bars it is the same arithmetic over minutes instead of months, and there is no reason for those constants to carry over.
